executionArgs.additionalInstruction: Round 2 rerun after bug fixes. Key changes since Round 1: (1) /api/sync-user now accepts email-only payloads, google_id is optional; (2) /api/debug/tables now returns tables as a dict {name: count}; (3) /api/demo-verify now includes verified_open: boolean on ALL response branches including errors; (4) /api/search is cache-only now, no live fallback — local dev DB has empty cache so search returns 0 jobs with warming=true, this is expected behavior not a bug; (5) /api/generate-cls blocking endpoint is capped to 1 job to stay under 30s.
